doc: Bars of the per-frame side gate (live/side_gate.py, side-gate.py): a frame fails when any measure crosses its bar ({max} or {min}); {unset} records why a measure has none (reported, not judged). "applies": "carried" marks the bars that ask for the truth's own pixels: they judge carried truth (X1c-style tests) and are left out for generated sides (side-gate.py --generated), which use "generated_max" where a bar has one. Since 2026-10-14 11:35 the user asked Claude to judge the quality itself: the carried bars sit at the measurement floor (25 % above the largest difference between the truth's own two copies, raw and through the world, on X1c's 6 moments), far below what the user saw in the ladder; the generated bars come from the user's ladder answers (half the size seen, see ladder_evidence). A bar is relaxed only with evidence that it fails what the user cannot see.

jump.source: two-sided |side change - truth change|. carried: floor 0.43 codes (reaching f40 right) x 1.25. generated: the 2.0 px ladder break measures 0.71 (mean of both sides)

detail_loss.source: 1 s running median: the truth's own two copies reach 0.923 (pan right); phase 3's 1 MP plates at 0.85 of today's best were seen (14/20, 16/20), 2 MP at 0.99 matched

boil.source: codec noise: a clip and its re-encode with a different side differ by at most 0.32 codes per frame off the changed frames; criterion 5: a side changes only with the picture
